title: Crispy Spanish Orange Chicken
description: A Chinese-inspired dish with crispy fried chicken, tangy orange sauce, and a hint of Spanish spice.
instructions: 1. In a shallow dish, mix together flour, cornstarch, and a pinch of salt. Dust the chicken pieces with the flour mixture.
2. Dip the floured chicken pieces in beaten eggs and then coat with flour mixture again.
3. Heat 1/2 cup of vegetable oil in a deep frying pan over medium-high heat. Fry the chicken pieces until golden brown and crispy.
4. Remove the fried chicken from the oil and set aside on a paper towel-lined plate.
5. In a small saucepan, combine orange juice, honey, soy sauce, rice vinegar, and garlic powder. Bring the mixture to a simmer over medium heat.
6. Reduce the heat to low and let the sauce simmer for 5-7 minutes or until thickened.
7. Add the fried chicken back into the saucepan and toss to coat with the orange sauce.
8. Serve the crispy Spanish orange chicken hot, garnished with sliced oranges and crispy fried shallots (optional).
